review_description: Very straight forward process getting a quote, install went ahead without any issues, the guys were responsive and showed how to use the system.Thanks very much for the install!

I recently had an incredible experience with GreenGen Solar for the installation of my solar panel and battery system, and I couldn’t be happier! From start to finish, their team was professional, knowledgeable, and dedicated to delivering top-notch service.Detailed & Transparent Quotation:Right from the initial consultation, GreenGen Solar provided an excellent, detailed quotation that broke down every aspect of the system, including panel efficiency, battery storage capacity, and expected energy savings. They took the time to answer all my questions, explaining the process, costs, and long-term benefits in a way that was easy to understand.Expert Guidance on Rebates & Incentives:One of the biggest highlights was their amazing help in securing all available rebates and incentives. They walked me through every step, ensuring I maximized my savings through government schemes and solar credits. Their expertise in this area alone saved me a significant amount of money!Punctual & Professional Installation:The installation team was punctual, efficient, and respectful of my property. They worked diligently, kept the worksite neat and tidy, and completed the job without any delays. The final installation is clean, sleek, and perfectly optimized for maximum energy production.Exceptional Customer Service:Throughout the entire process, GreenGen Solar maintained clear communication, providing updates and addressing any concerns promptly. Their commitment to customer satisfaction is truly outstanding.If you’re looking for a reliable, professional, and highly skilled solar installer, I wholeheartedly recommend GreenGen Solar. They exceeded my expectations in every way, and I’m thrilled with my new solar energy system!Thank you, GreenGen Solar – you’ve earned a loyal customer
Very good customer service communicated the whole process very well and made it easy to understand. Got everything sorted in good time from installation to grid connection
Dealt with Shennal who provided great service and value on the install of my solar panels.

My experience with GreenGenSolar, led by Shennal, for my single-story home's solar installation was outstanding from start to finish. The installation was very efficient and professional; a team of two on the roof and one on the ground completed the system within a single day. They were punctual, polite, and left the work area tidy. Furthermore, GreenGenSolar's customer service has been excellent, taking care of the grid connection process seamlessly and providing thorough guidance on how to use my new system, which has been performing flawlessly ever since.

Awesome service we got from Shennal and his team. Shennal was hands on from start to finish of the installation. Provided us with all the pertinent information we needed to know about solar. Installation process was carried out on time, details on the how the system works were clearly explained and organised all after installation requirements.

I chose GreenGen Solar because Shennal came around in person and looked at the roof which was going to be difficult.It was more difficult than he expected but they diligently persevered. There were quite a few broken tiles (70 year old concrete ones). They were patient and did a difficult job  properly.I give 5 stars to a trade that turns up on time and does what they say they will do. GreenGen Solar did all of that plus had to deal with complications plus they are a pleasure to do business with. Six stars.

I initially contacted Greengen Solar to inspect our old system as it was damaged from recent storms. Shennal came out and inspected and tested the old system and provided a quote for an upgrade. He made the whole process easy especially as it was dealing insurance companies to replace the system.Shennal pretty much took care of everything right up until install day. The Greengen crew arrived on time on the agreed day, installed the entire system and gave me a comprehensive run through all within a few hours. They organised the connection to the grid and all relevant procedures required for a solar install.The quality of work is amazing and I have every bit of confidence in recommending them to anyone looking at a solar system, either new or upgrade, they can handle it all.
Great service. Before start Shennal explained everything, him and his team turned up in time and done a carefully executed overall great job.Highly recommended
